title: Dochi's Wiki
description: Documentation for Dochi mods: RPG Maker, NPC Core, Cobblemon Editor, BattleWorks, Warfare, Spawn Control, Real Armor, Minigames and MapIcon Integration.

homeTasks.label: Create an NPC
homeTasks.description: Place your first NPC, then change its looks and equipment.
homeTasks.description_ko: NPC 한 명을 배치하고 외형과 장비를 바꿉니다.

homeTasks.label: Make conversations and shops
homeTasks.description: Give an NPC dialogue choices and a shop of your own.
homeTasks.description_ko: NPC에게 대화 선택지와 내 상점을 붙입니다.

homeTasks.label: Make a Pokémon trainer
homeTasks.description: Set a trainer's Pokémon and start your first battle.
homeTasks.description_ko: NPC의 포켓몬을 정하고 첫 배틀을 시작합니다.

homeTasks.label: Build NPC combat
homeTasks.description: Equip a gun or build an enemy's attack patterns.
homeTasks.description_ko: NPC에게 총을 들려주거나 적의 공격 패턴을 만듭니다.

homeTasks.label: Control mob spawning
homeTasks.description: Choose which mobs appear, where and when.
homeTasks.description_ko: 어떤 몹이 어디서, 언제 등장할지 정합니다.

homeTasks.label: Set up a minigame
homeTasks.description: Place game tables, choose rewards or learn MWENT.
homeTasks.description_ko: 게임 테이블과 보상을 정하거나 MWENT를 시작합니다.

homeImage.alt_ja: Dochi's Wiki のスクリーンショット

wikiMods.label: Dochi's NPC Core
wikiMods.description: Create NPCs, choose their looks and equipment, and give them daily jobs.
wikiMods.description_ko: NPC를 만들고 외형·장비를 꾸민 뒤 하루 일과와 작업을 정합니다.

wikiMods.label: Dochi's Warfare
wikiMods.description: Give NPCs guns, targets, reloads and tactical movement.
wikiMods.description_ko: NPC에게 총을 들려주고 공격 대상·재장전·전술 행동을 정합니다.

wikiMods.label: Dochi's Warfare Expanded
wikiMods.description: Add vehicle movement, NPC drivers/gunners and support strikes to Warfare.
wikiMods.description_ko: Warfare에 차량 이동·NPC 운전수와 포수·폭격 지원을 추가합니다.

wikiMods.label: Dochi's RPG Maker
wikiMods.description: Make NPC conversations, shops and quests, then customize their screens.
wikiMods.description_ko: NPC 대화·상점·퀘스트를 만들고 화면을 내 스타일로 꾸밉니다.

wikiMods.label: Dochi Cobblemon Editor
wikiMods.description: Create Pokémon trainers, shops, healers and starter choices.

wikiMods.label: MWENT — Minigames Card Game
wikiMods.description: Collect cards, build a faction deck and play against friends or AI.
wikiMods.description_ko: 카드를 모아 진영 덱을 만들고 친구나 AI와 겨룹니다.

wikiMods.label: Dochi`s Minigames
wikiMods.description: Place game tables for slots, memory, shooting and MWENT, with your own rules and rewards.
wikiMods.description_ko: 슬롯·기억력·사격장·MWENT 테이블을 놓고 규칙과 보상을 정합니다.

wikiMods.label: Dochi's RPG Maker Fabric / NeoForge 1.21.1 / 26.3
wikiMods.description: Make conversations, shops, quests and camera scenes on Fabric or NeoForge.

wikiMods.label: Dochi's Battleworks
wikiMods.description: Build enemy attacks, dodgeable hit areas and bosses that change with their health.
wikiMods.description_ko: 적의 공격·피할 수 있는 판정·체력에 따라 달라지는 보스 패턴을 만듭니다.

wikiMods.label: Dochi's Spawn Control
wikiMods.description: Choose where, when and how many mobs or saved NPCs appear.
wikiMods.description_ko: 어떤 몹과 NPC가 어디서·언제·몇 마리씩 등장할지 정합니다.

wikiMods.label: Dochi's Real Armor
wikiMods.description: Make equipped NPC armor reduce damage, with body-part and durability options.
wikiMods.description_ko: NPC가 입은 갑옷으로 피해를 줄이고 부위별 방어·내구도를 정합니다.

wikiMods.label: Dochi's MapIcon Integration
wikiMods.description: Mark NPC shops, trainers and services with icons on your map.
wikiMods.description_ko: 상점·트레이너·안내 NPC를 지도 아이콘으로 알아보기 쉽게 표시합니다.
